checks_passed.what_was_verified: There is no direct pathways provenance sidecar on disk. pathways.json is a projection of reactions.json, so output/reactions-provenance.json (13 entries, one per reaction_id, each with source_lines, quote, arithmetic_check and drawing_evidence) is the only provenance that grounds it. Every pathway step traces to a provenance entry through its reaction_id.

Diffed all 41 non-derived rule 11 fields for all 14 step instances across the 13 pathways against the matching record in reactions.json, mechanically, by exact equality on parsed JSON. Every field is byte-identical, including reaction_class, named_reaction, notes, procedure_text, procedure_summary, workup, purification, molar_ratio_text, scale, compounds, reactant_names, validation_flags and tags. No re-wording and no re-classification anywhere.

temperature_c equals conditions.temperature.value_c on all 14 step instances (null on the two range temperatures in Claims_Step 1/2 and the two in Process Conditions_Step 1/2, 90.0 on Example 1_Step 1). room_temperature equals conditions.temperature.type == room_temperature, and is false everywhere, correctly: line 122 and line 140 say reagents were added at room temperature but the reaction itself was heated. pressure equals conditions.pressure.value_kpa (null throughout), concentration equals conditions.concentration.text (null throughout), and time_h, atmosphere and reactor_type equal their conditions counterparts. yield_pct equals product_yield_pct and purity_pct equals product_purity_pct on every step.

checks_passed.check: rule 3, ksm is a skeleton contributor
checks_passed.what_was_verified: Checked all 13. Every ksm is the aryl substrate whose benzene ring survives into the product, never a brominating agent or initiator. The rule 3 trap is genuinely avoided at Background_Step 1, where the source names only azocarboxylic esters, azonitriles and an oxidizing agent alongside the substrate (line 55): ksm is methyl aromatics, not the oxidizing agent. No ksm is null, and none needed to be, because every earliest step in every chain does name a skeleton-contributing reactant.

Recomputed all 13. Three pathways have a complete yield set and all three are single-step: 88.4 (Example 1_Step 1, line 124), 95.6 (Example 2_Step 1, line 140) and 95.6 again on the patent-scope record. The other ten are null and all ten carry yield_missing_step. Nothing was substituted, assumed at 100 percent or averaged; in particular the two-step Background chain, where neither step has a yield, is null rather than carrying either step's absent number.

Equals the terminal step's product_purity_pct on all 13: 96.0 for Example 1 variant A (line 126), 88.0 for Example 2 and for the patent-scope record (line 142), null elsewhere. Example 1 variant B is correctly null rather than 87, because line 130 gives an HPLC composition of the reaction mixture, not a purity of an isolated solid, and the pathway records that with product_not_isolated_hplc_composition_only.

checks_passed.check: rule 1 and rule 4, chain construction and coverage
checks_passed.what_was_verified: All 13 reaction_ids in reactions.json appear in at least one section-scope pathway, so no reaction is silently lost. All seven sections that 00-sections.json marks contains_procedure (Abstract, Background, Summary of the Invention, Process Conditions, Example 1, Example 2, Claims) have at least one section-scope pathway. Exactly one chain has more than one step, Background_Step 2 then Background_Step 3, and its intermediates list is exactly the step 1 product, methyl 3-bromomethyl-2-chloro-4-methylsulfonylbenzoate, which line 56 confirms is hydrolysed to the free acid. All other pathways have intermediates: []. Every product is the terminal step's product.

Every one of the 22 step-level enrichment fields (scores, counts, atom_mapped_rxn, atom_map_confident, template_r0/r1/r2 and their hashes, canonical_rxn, reactant_smiles, smiles_source, product_smiles, product_smiles_source) is null on all 14 step instances, and every one of the 11 pathway-level aggregates is null on all 13 records. All ksm, intermediate and product CompoundRef objects have smiles null. compound_uuid and pathway_uuid are populated, which is finalise.py's job, not A3's.

Recomputed the tag union for all 13 from scratch: step tags, then ksm plus intermediate plus product compound tags from compounds.json, then chain_length:N, branching:linear, convergence:linear and the lcl band, deduplicated in first-seen order. The recomputed list is identical to the artifact's on every record. branching:linear and convergence:linear are correct everywhere, including the two-step Background chain. All tags match the category:value pattern with lowercase snake_case ASCII values.

Five step instances carry validation_flags, all of them the single flag no_conditions: Abstract_Step 1, Background_Step 1, Background_Step 2, Background_Step 3 and Summary of the Invention_Step 1. Every pathway built from them (indices 0, 1, 2 and 10) carries no_conditions_for_any_step in honest_uncertainty_flags. No pathway assembled from a flagged step presents itself as clean. The Background pathways additionally carry prior_art_route_not_the_claimed_invention, which is the right treatment for a route the source is criticising rather than claiming.

Exactly one patent-scope record, section_label null, terminating in 3-bromomethyl-2-chloro-4-ethylsulfonylbenzoic acid. I judge this defensible and would have chosen the same. The title (line 16) names a genus, so no single compound is unarguable, but claim 19 (line 191) claims formula II while expressly excluding 3-bromomethyl-2-chloro-4-methylsulfonylbenzoic acid, which is Example 1's product and which line 100 concedes to EP-A 0 292 944, and claim 20 (line 195) then narrows to R1 chlorine and R2 (C2)alkyl, which is exactly Example 2's product. It is the only compound the patent both makes with a stated yield and purity and claims as novel in its own right. The alternative readings, the formula II genus and Example 1's product, are both recorded in honest_uncertainty_flags rather than discarded.

Opened p01 to p04. Nine drawn structures: formula II in the abstract on p01; formulae II and I at [0004] and [0005] on p02; formula II at [0020] and formulae II and I inside claim 6 on p03; formulae II and I inside claim 13 and formula II inside claim 19 on p04. The enriched markdown has exactly nine IMAGE_EXTRACT spans (lines 42, 61, 65, 102, 144, 146, 177, 179, 193) and their placement matches the drawings one for one. Every drawn structure is the same Markush benzene: HOOC at C1, R1 at C2, CH2Br (formula II) or CH3 (formula I) at C3, SO2R2 at C4. That substitution pattern is what the names used throughout the artifact assert, so no substituent position was inferred rather than read. All nine spans carry {"molecules": []}, which is correct for a generic with variable R1 and R2 rather than a lost read. There is no drawn reaction scheme anywhere in this patent, so there is no above-arrow versus below-arrow reagent merge to get wrong, and the two background pathways are labelled prior_art_route_not_the_claimed_invention rather than presented as the invention's route.

Zero em dash characters in pathways.json. scope is section or patent only. All honest_uncertainty_flags are lowercase snake_case ASCII, including the ones invented beyond rule 15's list (ksm_is_a_class_term_not_a_discrete_substance, no_conditions_for_any_step, prior_art_route_not_the_claimed_invention, product_not_isolated_hplc_composition_only, reactant_charge_unreadable_in_source, the four patent_target_ codes), which rule 15 permits.
